name: growcam-pc
description: Local dashboard, daily rewind, and time-lapse tools for the VIVOSUN GrowCam C4
author: Nick2bad4u <20943337+Nick2bad4u@users.noreply.github.com> (https://github.com/Nick2bad4u)

scripts.check:python: npm run lint:python && npm run typecheck:python && npm run test:python && npm run compile:python
scripts.compile:python: uv run python -m compileall -q src tests
scripts.format: npm run format:python && npm run lint:remark:fix
scripts.format:python: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:remark && npm run lint:secretlint
scripts.lint:lychee: lychee --config node_modules/lychee-config-nick2bad4u/lychee.toml --exclude "^.*pypi[.]org/project/growcam-pc/?$" --exclude "^https://nick2bad4u[.]github[.]io/?$" --exclude "^https://nick2bad4u[.]github[.]io/growcam-pc/docs/growcam-c4-setup/?$" --exclude "^.*github[.]com/Nick2bad4u/growcam-pc/compare/v1[.]0[.]0[.][.][.]v1[.]1[.]0$" --exclude "^.*github[.]com/Nick2bad4u/growcam-pc/compare/v1[.]1[.]0[.][.][.]HEAD$" README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md website
scripts.lint:python: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.release:verify: npm run check:python && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:remark && npm run lint:secretlint && npm run build:python && npm run check:package && npm run docs:build && npm run changelog:preview:offline
scripts.typecheck:python: npm run typecheck:mypy && npm run typecheck:pyright
scripts.update-deps: ncu --configFileName .ncurc.json --configFilePath node_modules/ncu-config-nick2bad4u && npm update --force && npm install --force
